Marble 1.1 independent desk-photo applicability trial.
Source: the complete original user-provided photograph, unchanged.
Cloud generation is subject to World Labs service terms; this code does not
redistribute World Labs model weights or claim an open model license.
https://www.worldlabs.ai/terms-of-service

Marble results are generated interpretations. Hidden geometry is not observed
ground truth. Camera registration must be checked before judging alignment.
No photograph overlay or postprocessing blur is used during orbiting. The
explicit reference button is for the zero-degree registration check only.
The original photograph remains separate in the left reference panel.

Renderer: existing Three.js and Spark, with original notices retained under
../vendor/ and ../gs-lab/vendor/. Generated images and SPZ files are local-only.
No existing demonstration or experiment is replaced by this page.
